title: A Hybrid Attention Model Learning Unified Time-aware Patch Representation for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.22836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently delivered impressive zero-shot performance across diverse forecasting tasks. However, real-world decision-making frequently relies on \emph{irregular multivariate time series} (IMTS), where inconsistent inter-observation intervals and asynchronous sampling across variables coexist with informative missingness. Existing TSFMs handle such inputs either through imputation that injects spurious values or through index-based positional encodings that ignore continuous time. There is still a gap in the foundation model that follows the original IMTS patterns. translated_title: 一种学习统一时间感知补丁表示用于不规则多变量时间序列预测的混合注意力模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）最近在多种预测任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的零样本性能。然而，现实世界的决策制定经常依赖于不规则多变量时间序列（IMTS），其中观测时间间隔不一致、跨变量采样异步，并与信息性缺失并存。现有的TSFMs处理此类输入的方式，要么是通过注入虚假值的插补方法，要么是采用忽略连续时间的基于索引的位置编码。遵循原始IMTS模式的基础模型仍然存在空白。在本文中，我们提出了一种混合注意力模型，为IMTS预测学习统一的时间感知补丁表示。我们首先设计了一种时间感知补丁编码，将补丁内数量可变的时间戳映射为固定大小的嵌入，从而在无需借助插补的情况下为不规则补丁产生统一格式
tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合注意力模型，通过时间感知补丁编码将不规则时间戳映射为固定大小嵌入，无需插补即可实现对不规则多变量时间序列的统一表示与预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a hybrid attention model with time-aware patch encoding that maps variable numbers of irregular timestamps into fixed-size embeddings, enabling unified representation and forecasting of irregular multivariate time series without imputation.
